rates.notification_ref: Karnataka Minimum Wages Notification, effective 01.04.2025
rates.caution: Deliberately kept on this pre-dispute rate. A 22.05.2026 KA notification (~55-60% higher, uniform across 81 scheduled employments) exists but is under Karnataka HC stay (WP 22771/2025) and was issued citing an already-repealed act (Code on Wages, 2019 took effect 21.11.2025) — Karnataka Employers Association disputes its legal authority. A separate April 2026 'FY26-27' annual DA increment (~Rs 14,559-19,972/mo) may also exist on the original pre-dispute framework, distinct from the disputed 22.05.2026 notification. Neither newer figure has been confirmed against a primary gazette as of this check (Sept 2026). Do not switch off this rate until one is.
